jevgrep: Additional all-600 RepoQA native adapter, 4 concurrent query workers with per-query default 32 API concurrency, 180s timeout and 1000 requests cap. Network-inclusive durations measured under this concurrency, not isolated CLI latency. CoSQA alternatives follow previous comparison; Jevgrep not evaluated on CoSQA.
selection: All queries unchanged, all failures retained, no retrieval tuning. RepoQA file rank plus 2000/8000 o200k token source coverage; CoSQA unique snippet Hit@1/5/10 and MRR@10.
failure_contract: Reject out-of-corpus results or fabricated source
Deduplicate file ranks and source lines
No labels or generated config prose in corpus
Separate indexed setup from query latency
Do not present network concurrent timings as isolated local CLI timings
local_timing: Fresh CLI processes; sequential rotated method order in the original benchmark, warmed model/parser/OS caches. Dedicated sgrep index. CK lexical subsequently measured in its own complete repair pass. An additional baseline arm in the original timing rotation is omitted from this publication.
indexing: Reuse existing validated CK indexes where present, incremental initialization for missing files; no fresh-build claims for this run. Measure sgrep-main empty scope index warmups separately.
host_suspend_correction: 30 queries repeated using the same >5s wall/monotonic-gap rule, regardless of score or native status. All original records retained. Most retries before local timing; final two after local timing. Temporary keep-awake assertion protected the local pass.
lexical_index_correction: Rebuilt derived Tantivy indexes at copied corpus paths and reran all 1,100 lexical queries unchanged. Original path-stale attempts preserved; lexical timing is a separate pass.

publication.source_verification: 60 RepoQA source-snapshot hashes and 6,267 CoSQA snippet hashes verified; zero independent rank disagreements.
